interpretation: All throughput/quality claims in cards are publisher claims; no candidate outperforms incumbents until identical task contracts are tested.
HF created/modified dates are repository metadata, not release dates or quality evidence. Granite4.2 card explicitly states release2026-08-25.
Advertised artifact SHA256 values are HF LFS metadata, not locally verified digests. Sizes are download weights only, excluding runtime, KV cache, activations and concurrency.

No runtime revision or adapter has been qualified by this discovery. New role endpoints must be admitted through existing Manwe/Hermes contracts without lowering continuation floors for roles which still own continuation.

Essential services, storage/backups and recovery inventory precede Beelink inference. Use on-demand bounded CPU experiments first; shared RAM is not dedicated GPU VRAM. Do not infer working ROCm/Vulkan acceleration.

top3_role_tests.contract: Extract/classify/summarize supplied Arda incident and maintenance snippets into strict JSON; source IDs and verbatim evidence spans; missing facts must be null. Include a source-bounded research sub-suite with conflicting dates, distractors and unanswerable questions.
top3_role_tests.fixtures: 60 held-out snippets:20 extraction,20 classification,20 evidence-grounded summaries; compare existing Qwen3.5-4B control and Phi4-mini under identical input/output budgets. Start max4K input/512 output; no tools or external actions.
top3_role_tests.proposed_gate: 100% schema validity; zero invented IDs/actions/quotes; macroF1>=0.90 classification and exact-field accuracy>=0.95 extraction; summary claims manually checked against spans. Report abstention precision/recall separately. These are proposed acceptance thresholds, not observed results.
top3_role_tests.placement: First isolated authorized slot on one server GPU; later Beelink CPU only after inventory. Exercise background classification alongside one unchanged interactive stream; record p50/p95 latency, peak RAM/VRAM, cancel latency and service health; do not promote until operator contention budget agreed.

top3_role_tests.contract: Read-only review of supplied Rust/Python diff plus exact relevant context; findings with file/line/evidence and confidence. No repository navigation, edits or command execution.
top3_role_tests.fixtures: 20 reviewed fixtures:10 known bugs,5 clean,5 insufficient-context. Include prior Python truthiness factual failure, async cancellation and SQL authority boundaries. Same prompt/budget against existing MiMo and remote frontier control where authenticated access is verified.
top3_role_tests.proposed_gate: At least90% finding precision,80% seeded-bug recall, zero invented files/lines, correct truthiness explanations; abstain on missing context. Review blinded; usefulness and latency scored separately.
top3_role_tests.placement: Only after quant-license and llama.cpp PR17945/template prerequisites. Server RAM plus authorized single-GPU offload, short4K/8K context, no dual-service pause assumed. If offload misses agreed review latency budget, retain as infeasible configuration rather than reject quality.

top3_role_tests.contract: Genuine operator dictation into Hermes draft text; NEVER execute recognized commands without confirmation.
top3_role_tests.fixtures: 30 consented utterances including Arda names, paths, punctuation, corrections, quiet/noisy speech; additionally10 silence/non-speech clips. Compare existing Whisper-large-v3-turbo baseline.
top3_role_tests.proposed_gate: WER no worse than existing baseline, >=95% exact key names/paths, zero silence-induced actionable command text; report p50/p95 end-of-speech latency and real-time factor. Confirm microphone/VAD and actual listening workflow, not synthetic-only acceptance.
top3_role_tests.placement: Offline short chunks via official Transformers backend before streaming adapter. Core or one server GPU only when authorized; test CPU feasibility separately before Beelink residency. Voxtral fallback requires separate memory/runtime preflight.
